_note: Reference-example values from the design spec. Replace with real scorecard output (Scripts/coaching_scorecard.py) when the model/data bundle is available.

metrics.label: Tempo (back : down)
metrics.blurb: How smooth your timing is from backswing to downswing.

metrics.label: Shoulder turn at top
metrics.blurb: How far your shoulders rotate away from the ball at the top.

metrics.label: X-factor (coil)
metrics.blurb: The stretch between your shoulder turn and hip turn — stored power.

metrics.label: Hip rotation at impact
metrics.blurb: How open your hips are to the target when the club meets the ball.

metrics.label: Spine tilt at address
metrics.blurb: How much you bend forward from the hips at setup.

metrics.label: Posture change
metrics.blurb: How much your spine angle shifts between address and impact.

metrics.label: Head sway
metrics.blurb: How far your head drifts sideways during the swing (relative to body size).

metrics.label: Weight shift (lateral)
metrics.blurb: How much your hips drive toward the target coming into impact.

metrics.label: Lead-arm extension
metrics.blurb: How straight your lead arm stays at the top — width and structure.
